prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: wide 16:9 editorial hero illustration for the third Ranking Rebels blog, an Australian service-business article about AI agents versus workflow automation.
Primary request: show a small service-business team turning an incomplete enquiry into a useful quote brief. A person at a desk studies an incoming email represented as a paper envelope and a simple blank enquiry sheet, with another team member reviewing a prepared clipboard brief. A few orderly document and tool symbols connect the work between them; the person preparing the quote remains visibly involved.
Style/medium: sophisticated hand-drawn editorial pen-and-ink illustration, detailed crosshatching and coarse halftone print texture, bold silhouettes, restrained screen-print collage depth. Match an established business journal whose previous illustrations depict everyday people using search and maps with crisp ivory paper elements against near-black.
Scene/backdrop: understated Australian commercial service office, a window suggesting a modest commercial premises, no recognisable city landmarks.
Composition/framing: landscape 16:9 with the main people and work centred, important faces and objects comfortably inside the frame so the image remains legible when reduced to a 768px blog illustration. Make the work understandable without labels.
Color palette: near-black #050609, off-white #f8fafc, slate grey #94a3b8, selective crimson-red #ff304f accents on the enquiry and links between documents. No other saturated colours.
Lighting/mood: thoughtful and practical, dramatic yet calm. Rich near-black areas balanced by generous light paper shapes and clear human gestures.
Text: none. Blank or abstract document marks only.
Constraints: no readable lettering, logos, brand marks, watermarks, humanoid robots, glowing AI brains, neon gradients, fake software screenshots, fake analytics, invented numbers, charts, or geographic maps. Natural hands and believable interaction with the clipboard. The image is a conceptual illustration, not a photograph or a claimed client case.
processing: Source copied unchanged into the workspace; Sharp used for 16:9 resizing and WebP optimisation at quality 84. Original generation retained.
